The duties and responsibilities for a IT Project Manager (NETWORK/INFOSEC) GS-2210-13 generally include, but are not limited to, the following: Monitor infrastructure performance, availability, reliability, resiliency, operational readiness, and service dependencies; resolve complex operational issues.

Coordinate with budget, acquisition, contracting, program, and technical personnel to ensure effective management of IT resources. Develop network project plans, technical requirements, implementation strategies, schedules, milestones, and resource requirements.

Provide technical recommendations to contracting officials regarding contract administration, modifications, deliverable acceptance, schedule changes, and performance issues. Lead cross-functional teams of technical staff, program officials, contractors, vendors, and internal/external stakeholders.
To qualify for the position of IT Project Manager (NETWORK/INFOSEC), at GS-2210-13, you must meet the basic qualification requirements listed below. Basic Qualifications (2210 series): Please refer to the OPM IT Management Series 2210 Qualification Standard for the specific experience requirements for the GS-12 and above positions.

AND Specialized Experience: To qualify for the GS-13 grade level, you must have one (1) year of specialized experience equivalent to at least the GS-12 grade level in the Federal service, or comparable non-Federal experience.

Specialized experience is defined as experience performing the following duties: Participate in the planning execution and monitoring enterprise IT projects involving network services, information security, and/or telecommunications. You MUST meet all qualification requirements by the 09/04/2026 of this announcement.

Your resume must support your responses to the application questionnaire and the qualification requirements. Failure to do so may result in an ineligible rating. See the Required Documents section for important notes about what must be included in your resume.

After you submit this application, you will receive an e-mail informing you that a USA Hire assessment is required of you. You will have 48 hours from the closing date of this announcement 09/04/2026 to complete the assessment as this assessment is part of your application.

This is a Direct Hire Authority (DHA) solicitation utilizing the DHA for Acq Demo Business and Technical Management to recruit and appoint qualified candidates to positions in the competitive service.

As a Program Manager at the NH-0340-4 broadband level, some of your typical work assignments may include: Serves at the Program Manager (PM) for the Missile Defense Space Enterprise Architecture (MDSEA) to include the Missile Defense Space Center, Satellite Operations Center (SOC) and Test and Integration Lab (TIL) at the Missile Defense Integration and Operations Center (MDIOC).

Will serve as the Program Manager for the Organic Ground Entry Point contract and other space-ground communication efforts.

Act as the responsible authority for the end-to-end execution, integration, delivery, and demonstration of space capabilities, such as satellites and ground systems, ensuring programs meet cost, schedule, and performance requirements. MDSEA is the critical ground command control system enabling MDA's space operations.
You may qualify at the NH 04 Broadband Level, if you fulfill the following qualifications: A.

One year of specialized experience equivalent to the NH-03/GS-13 grade level in the Federal service as listed below and must meet 2 of the 3 specialized experience listed below to be qualified: Executing research and development of Acquisition systems or Major Capabilities Acquisition pathways for delivery of space capabilities.

Utilizing of acquisition authorities such as Other Transactions. Managing and integrating space and associated ground and communication systems.

Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religious; spiritual; community, student, social).

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

The United States Space Force (USSF) at Clear Space Force Station, Alaska is searching for a IT/Cyber COR/QA Program Manager to support 13 SWS (OBN) (NH-2210-03, GS-12/13 equivalent).

Description: Manages the Information Technology (IT)/Cyber Communications (Comm) Quality Assurance (QA) Program and performs QA evaluation and documentation of contractor performance.

Conducts inspections in Communications Operations, Computer Operations, Radar Maintenance, Computer Maintenance, Site Maintenance Management, LAN/WAN, Site Security Systems, Administrative Telephone Systems, and other assigned areas.

Determines contractor compliance with technical directives, quality, safety, timeliness, Air Force Instructions, and other contract requirements.

Develops the inspection schedule for contractor-supplied services and maintains/updates Quality Assurance Surveillance Plans (QASPs), Statements of Work (SOWs), contract modifications, inspection logs, and activity records.

Assesses policy needs and develops, approves, and interprets policy and procedures governing Information Technology (IT) and cybersecurity activities.

Serves as the Information Systems Security Manager (ISSM), establishing, maintaining, and enforcing the organization's cybersecurity program in accordance with the DoD Risk Management Framework (RMF), DoDI 8500.01, DoDI 8510.01, and applicable Air Force/Space Force cybersecurity guidance.

Interprets DoD, AF, and higher headquarters guidance and applies it locally, coordinating across organizations to develop, revise, and modify policies and assessing impacts on business requirements.

Manages the Assessment and Authorization (A&A) process, prepares and maintains system security authorization packages, and supports Authorizing Official (AO) decisions to achieve and sustain Authorizations to Operate (ATO) Provides technical expertise in the acquisition and installation of large, complex operating system environments, including personal computers, LAN servers, components, and associated software.

Independently oversees testing, migration, and cutover with minimal disruption and provides post-implementation support. Ensures appropriate configuration and sufficient system resources for new applications. Establishes project plans, priorities, and implementation schedules to ensure continuity of operations.

Evaluates operating system design requirements and consults with developers on impacts to end-user applications. Oversees hardware/software setup and configuration per the technical design plan, coordinating installation and sustainment with IT, telecommunications specialists, and the database manager.

Serves as the Contracting Officer's Representative (COR) for the installation Comm/Cyber contract, performing contract administration duties designated in the CO's Letter of Designation.

Prepares Corrective Action Reports (CARs), documents deficiencies, analyzes contractor responses for root cause and corrective actions, and performs follow-up to resolution. Reviews technical specifications, requirements, and procurement request documents; leads technical proposal reviews; and determines adequacy of vendor capability.

Serves as liaison between the Commander, Contracting Officer, contractor, Director of Mission Assurance, and other Air Force/Space Force personnel.

Coordinates with the SCIF Manager, SSO, security personnel, and Authorizing Official chain on personnel access, SCI indoctrination, cybersecurity risk, and security incidents, violations, or deviations affecting information systems and the SCIF. Participates in meetings to resolve problems, discuss procedures, and review contractor performance.

Notifies the Senior Quality Assurance Evaluator, supervisor, and Contract Quality Program Manager of deficiencies, prepares file documentation, and recommends changes to surveillance methods as warranted.

Ideal Candidate: Purpose: The purpose of this position is to support the Communications and Cyber Quality Assurance (QA) program by providing the unit commander, director, and senior leadership with a comprehensive assessment of the unit's ability to perform key logistics processes.

This is accomplished by ensuring standardized, repeatable, and technically compliant process execution, while promoting a culture of professional excellence and personal responsibility. The primary focus is on personnel proficiency and adherence to established policies and procedures.
The 2210 series has an individual occupational requirement that must be met and can be viewed here. There is no Group Coverage Qualification Standard for this series.

About DMI DMI is a leading provider of digital services and technology solutions, headquartered in Tysons Corner, VA. With a focus on end-to-end managed IT services, including managed mobility, cloud, cybersecurity, network operations, and application development, DMI supports public sector agencies and commercial enterprises around the globe.

Recognized as a Top Workplace, DMI is committed to delivering secure, efﬁcient, and cost-effective solutions that drive measurable results.

Learn more at www.dminc.com About the Opportunity DMI , LLC is seeking a Project Manager to lead day-to-day contract delivery for the American Battle Monuments Commission's Microsoft Enterprise Support Services contract, overseeing all CLINs, quality control, and stakeholder reporting.

This role serves as the primary point of contact with the ABMC Contracting Officer and COR, ensuring that SLA commitments, deliverable schedules, and contract compliance obligations are met across a Microsoft 365, Azure, and Power Platform environment.

The Project Manager works closely with all key personnel to maintain program velocity and governance integrity throughout the base year and option periods.

Duties and Responsibilities: Develop and deliver the Program Management Plan within 10 business days of contract award, establishing baselines for scope, schedule, risk, and deliverable ownership across all CLINs.

Produce and submit the Monthly Contract Status Report covering completed work by CLIN, hours used, schedule progress, open risks, deliverable status, ticket trends, service level results, and decision points requiring ABMC input. Notify the Contracting Officer and COR in writing when authorized hours or funding reaches 80% of the applicable ceiling.

Manage key personnel availability, providing written notification to the CO/COR within one business day if a key team member becomes unavailable, and submitting a qualified replacement candidate within five business days.

Coordinate CLIN 0001 transition activities, including access and dependency tracking, documentation gap assessment, risk register maintenance, and readiness reporting. Oversee the Quality Control Plan (QCP) and corrective action processes, issuing formal Corrective Action Plans when required by the PWS.

Manage CO-authorized work scope, ensuring no work is performed outside CO authorization and that no billable hours are charged for replacement personnel onboarding. Serve as primary liaison between ABMC leadership, the CO/COR, and the technical delivery team, facilitating escalation resolution and change control decisions.

Qualifications Education and Years of Experience: Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field.

An equivalent combination of education and eight or more years of directly relevant federal IT program management experience will be considered in lieu of the degree requirement. 7+ years of experience managing federal IT services contracts in a program or project management capacity, including direct client-facing responsibility with government Contracting Officers and CORs.

Required Skills & Certifications: Demonstrated experience managing Time and Materials and Firm-Fixed-Price CLINs concurrently, including invoice accuracy, ceiling tracking, and deliverable compliance. Proficiency with ITSM and project management platforms (ServiceNow or equivalent ticketing system, Azure DevOps or equivalent sprint tracking).

Experience producing Program Management Plans, Monthly Status Reports, and Corrective Action Plans as formal government deliverables. PMP certification (Project Management Professional). DMI recommended minimum. Strong working knowledge of GSA MAS IT Schedule contract administration requirements.

Preferred Skills & Certifications: ITIL 4 Foundation certification or higher. Experience supporting Microsoft 365 or Azure managed services programs in a federal civilian agency environment. Familiarity with change control board (CCB) processes and Section 508 acceptance procedures.

Prior experience managing contracts with multiple interdependent CLINs under a T&M ceiling structure. Background Requirements: Must possess or be eligible to obtain and complete a Public Trust background investigation and/or a Public Trust clearance. Citizenship Status Required: Must be a U.S.

Citizen Physical Requirements: None required for this position. Location: Remote, US Minimum Salary Rate $95,914.50 Median Salary Rate $105,186.00 Working at DMI DMI is a diverse, prosperous, and rewarding place to work.

Job Description Job Title: Associate, IT Project Manager Department Name: MIS Effective Date: 2.13.2026 Reports to (title): Director, IT # of Direct Reports: 0 # Indirect Reports: 0 Individual Contributor: XX Yes No Full Time/Part Time: Full time # Hours Per Week: 40-55 Average Work Schedule: Monday – Friday 8:00 – 5:00 Location: Remote Job Summary: Associate IT Project Manager will support and partially lead delivery across multiple IT initiatives, including a major Salesforce implementation over the next 18 months.

This role partners closely, technical leads, and business stakeholders to coordinate workstreams, maintain project structure, and manage portions of the project lifecycle. This role requires one to be highly organized, collaborative, and proactive.

This role reports to the Director of Information Technology and will be poised to grow into full project ownership.

Scope of job: The Associate IT Project Manager supports and partially leads delivery across multiple IT initiatives using a hybrid Agile/Waterfall approach, with near‑term focus on a major Salesforce implementation over the next 18 months.

The role coordinates assigned workstreams (e.g., requirements, testing, training), maintains core project artifacts (schedules, RAID logs, resource trackers), monitors risks and dependencies, facilitates smaller cross‑functional sessions, drafts executive-ready updates, and contributes to SIT/UAT, cutover, and hyper‑care readiness.

The Associate Project Manager improves templates and processes, helps translate technical updates into business terms, and partners closely with senior PMs, technical leads, and business stakeholders to ensure predictable delivery and clean operational handoffs. Duties/Responsibilities: Project Delivery (Hybrid Methodology)
· Assist in managing IT projects from planning through closure using a hybrid Agile/Waterfall approach.
· Contribute to developing project artifacts such as schedules, scope summaries, RAID logs, and resource trackers.
· Maintain and update integrated project plans under guidance from senior PMs.
· Monitor risks, issues, and dependencies; escalate appropriately and recommend preliminary mitigation options.
· Support delivery controls including weekly status reporting, action tracking, and change documentation. Salesforce Implementation Support & Partial Ownership
· Coordinate assigned Salesforce workstreams (e.g., requirements documentation, configuration tracking, testing coordination).
· Support data readiness, migration planning, and integration tracking by gathering updates and maintaining structured documentation.
· Assist with SIT/UAT planning, defect tracking, and training logistics.
· Contribute to cutover and go-live readiness planning by preparing checklists and consolidating readiness inputs.
· Maintain organized repositories of deliverables and help ensure alignment across internal teams. Stakeholder Engagement & Communication
· Facilitate smaller working sessions and assist senior PMs with larger cross-functional meetings.
· Prepare agendas, meeting notes, follow-up actions, and status updates.
· Draft executive-ready summaries and dashboards for review by senior PMs.
· Help translate technical updates into clear, business-friendly communication. Quality, Readiness & Operational Handoff
· Support testing coordination, defect triage, and validation cycles.
· Assist with cutover planning, go-live checklists, and hyper-care coordination.
· Help prepare operational handoff materials including documentation, support models, and runbooks. Process & Continuous Improvement
· Maintain and improve project templates, trackers, and documentation standards.
· Participate in lessons-learned sessions and help identify opportunities to improve delivery processes.
· Recommend practical improvements to streamline coordination and increase predictability. Required Skills/Abilities:
· Working knowledge of project management concepts (scope, schedule, risks, dependencies).
· Strong communication and organizational skills with growing confidence in stakeholder engagement.
· Proficiency with Smartsheet/MS Project, Jira/Confluence, and Microsoft 365 (Teams/SharePoint).
· Preferred: exposure to Salesforce projects, data migration, or testing workstreams; interest in pursuing PMP or similar certification. Education, Experience, and/or Certifications:
· Minimum of 3 years of experience in IT project coordination, junior project management, or PMO support.
· Experience supporting enterprise application or infrastructure projects. Competencies: Physical Requirements: Prolonged periods of sitting and working on a computer. Must be able to lift up-to 30 pounds at times. Must be able to see, hear, and listen, to effectively communicate. Must be able to travel up to 25% to El Paso Originally posted on Himalayas

This position will have to coordinate with headquarters project stakeholders/sponsors and align operational requirements documentation with technical requirements documentation, such as configuration and space standards. Being a Coast Guard civilian makes you a valuable member of the Coast Guard team.

Typical work assignments include: Coordinate with operational and program offices on infrastructure requirements documentation to support the development, planning, prioritization, and execution of US Coast Guard shore facility projects.

Review and evaluate shore infrastructure standards, technical orders, and planning guidance to ensure facility documentation is accurate, aligned with regulations, and supports project analysis and decision-making.

Analyze and validate project needs requests and planning documents to determine technical feasibility, cost effectiveness, compliance, and alignment with operational and mission requirements.

Investigate and resolve infrastructure planning and engineering issues involving USCG real property, construction, renovation, and sustainment projects to support effective project execution and long-term asset management.

Prepare and present technical reports, briefings, recommendations, and project updates to management officials, stakeholders, and project teams to support infrastructure planning, policy development, and project approval decisions.

Basic Requirements: This position has a positive Education Requirement in addition to at least one year of Specialized Experience or substitution of education for experience or combination (if applicable) in order to be found minimally qualified. Transcripts must be submitted with your application package.

You MUST meet the following requirements: EDUCATION: A.

Degree: Engineering - To be acceptable, the program must: (1) lead to a bachelor's degree in a school of engineering with at least one program accredited by ABET; or (2) include differential and integral calculus and courses (more advanced than first-year physics and chemistry) in five of the following seven areas of engineering science or physics: (a) statics, dynamics; (b) strength of materials (stress-strain relationships); (c) fluid mechanics, hydraulics; (d) thermodynamics; (e) electrical fields and circuits; (f) nature and properties of materials (relating particle and aggregate structure to properties); and (g) any other comparable area of fundamental engineering science or physics, such as optics, heat transfer, soil mechanics, or electronics.

OR B.

Combination of education and experience -- college-level education, training, and/or technical experience that furnished (1) a thorough knowledge of the physical and mathematical sciences underlying engineering, and (2) a good understanding, both theoretical and practical, of the engineering sciences and techniques and their applications to one of the branches of engineering.

The adequacy of such background must be demonstrated by one of the following: Professional registration or licensure -- Current registration as an Engineer Intern (EI), Engineer in Training (EIT), or licensure as a Professional Engineer (PE) by any State, the District of Columbia, Guam, or Puerto Rico.

Absent other means of qualifying under this standard, those applicants who achieved such registration by means other than written test (e.g., State grandfather or eminence provisions) are eligible only for positions that are within or closely related to the specialty field of their registration.

For example, an applicant who attains registration through a State Board's eminence provision as a manufacturing engineer typically would be rated eligible only for manufacturing engineering positions.

Written Test -- Evidence of having successfully passed the Fundamentals of Engineering (FE) examination or any other written test required for professional registration by an engineering licensure board in the various States, the District of Columbia, Guam, and Puerto Rico.

Specified academic courses -- Successful completion of at least 60 semester hours of courses in the physical, mathematical, and engineering sciences and that included the courses specified in the basic requirements under paragraph A.

The courses must be fully acceptable toward meeting the requirements of an engineering program as described in paragraph A.

Related curriculum -- Successful completion of a curriculum leading to a bachelor's degree in an appropriate scientific field, e.g., engineering technology, physics, chemistry, architecture, computer science, mathematics, hydrology, or geology, may be accepted in lieu of a bachelor's degree in engineering, provided the applicant has had at least 1 year of professional engineering experience acquired under professional engineering supervision and guidance.

Ordinarily there should be either an established plan of intensive training to develop professional engineering competence, or several years of prior professional engineering-type experience, e.g., in interdisciplinary positions.

(The above examples of related curricula are not all inclusive.) AND To qualify at the GS-13 grade level, your resume must demonstrate at least one (1) full year of specialized experience equivalent to at least the GS-12 grade level in the federal sector.

Specialized experience is experience that has equipped you with the ability, skill, and knowledge to successfully perform the duties of this position and is typically in or related to this line of work. Examples of specialized experience include performing the following types of tasks on a regular basis.

Specialized experience must include the following: Reviewing and processing purchase requests, contract documents, or procurement actions to ensure accuracy, completeness, and compliance with policies and procedures.

Coordinating with customers, vendors, contractors, or program offices to gather requirements, resolve issues, and support purchasing or project activities. Analyzing documents, data, or requests to identify discrepancies, determine requirements, and recommend appropriate solutions or corrective actions.

Reviewing regulations, technical guidance, or operating procedures to ensure purchases, projects, or administrative actions comply with applicable standards and requirements.

Preparing reports, correspondence, estimates, spreadsheets, or briefings to communicate procurement status, project information, or recommendations to management and stakeholders.

NOTE: All experience statements (i.e., duties, specialized experience, or related applicable assessment) copied from this announcement and pasted into your resume will not be considered as a demonstration of your qualifications for this position. NOTE: Education can not be substituted for experience at this grade level.

National Service Experience (i.e., volunteer experience): Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional, philanthropic, religious, spiritual, community, student, social).

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

WHAT DOES A SPEAKER BUREAU IMPLEMENTATION MANAGER DO? THE POSITION : The Speaker Bureau Implementation Manager is responsible for the management, launch, and optimization of speaker bureaus within our proprietary platform.

This role leads new bureau implementations, drives continuous operational and technology enhancements, and ensures seamless platform performance across program lifecycles.

The position requires strong team and client collaboration, strategic and solution-oriented thinking, and the ability to navigate evolving priorities across multiple clients and stakeholders within the speaker bureau industry.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: Our employees are tasked with delivering excellent business results through the efforts of their teams. These results are achieved by:
Develop and maintain a comprehensive understanding of portal functionality, applying strategic thinking to assess, address, and resolve business needs
Attend and participate in new project briefings, kickoff meetings, and bureau launch planning sessions
Provide input based on knowledge and experience to support program structure, budgets, and operational strategy
Identify operational and system improvement opportunities to enhance program execution and drive efficiency
Own the development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of work instructions for all task processes
Assists with speaker bureau launches, ensuring client’s customized components are implemented accurately and in alignment with timelines and expectations
Translate program specifics into team playbooks and training materials for new and existing bureaus
Demonstrate a commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion through continuous development, modeling inclusive behaviors, and proactively managing bias.

Serve as primary business owner for the speaker bureau platform/portal
Continuously evaluate portal performance and identify opportunities for automation, reporting enhancements, and usability improvements
Work directly with internal developers to translate business and client needs into clear technical requirements and functional solutions
Conduct thorough and ongoing system testing, including user acceptance testing (UAT), to validate functionality, identify issues, and ensure successful deployment of enhancements
Lead implementation of process improvements to address identified gaps across workflows, systems, and program execution.
Provide guidance, training, and ongoing support for speaker bureau portal and processes both internally and externally
Communicate program updates, system changes, and enhancements effectively, ensuring stakeholder alignment and understanding.
Support and coordinate Veeva submission processes related to portal materials.
Pivot across multiple programs and priorities to support business demands, new launches, and evolving client needs

Travel up to 20% for client meetings and launches or trainings.

Hours 40 hours, Monday - Friday

## Description de l'entreprise ##
Avec plus de 13'000 collaborateurs et collaboratrices représentant 160 métiers, les Hôpitaux Universitaires de Genève sont un établissement de référence au niveau national et international. Pour en savoir plus sur notre institution, prenez quelques minutes pour consulter notre rétrospective 2025 en cliquant ici.
La Direction des soins incarne l-autorité en matière de soins. Elle a pour mission de garantir la qualité et la sécurité des soins au sein de l'établissement. A ce titre, la Direction des soins a droit de regard sur l-ensemble des activités des soins (infirmiers, infirmières et différents corps professionnels de santé).

Pour remplir sa mission, elle s-appuie sur trois pôles d'expertises : qualité, durabilité et innovation digitale ; expertise clinique et pratiques professionnelles ; management et transformation.
## Description du poste ##
La direction des soins est à la recherche de son ou sa future responsable diététicienne pour manager et accompagner les équipes sur le site de Cluse-Roseraie dans leurs prestations dans différents départements médicaux. La patientèle peut être adulte comme pédiatrique notamment dans le domaine des soins aigus ainsi que pour l-enseignement thérapeutique au décours de la maladie chronique.
Vous dirigez une équipe d-environ 30 collaborateurs et collaboratrices. Vous organisez, coordonnez et supervisez leurs activités et prévoyez toute action nécessaire de développement des compétences individuelles comme collectives. Vous garantissez une circulation optimale des informations, qu-elle soit ascendante, descendante et/ ou transversale. Vous développez un climat de confiance dans l-équipe nécessaire au bien vivre et travailler ensemble dans le respect des valeurs institutionnelles.
Vous savez donner le cap et accompagner vos équipes pour atteindre des objectifs communs. Vous déclinez les axes stratégiques de votre métier en objectifs réalisables par l-équipe tout en veillant à la contribution individuelle de chaque membre.
En qualité de responsable d-équipe, vous êtes garante ou garant de la qualité des soins nutritionnels et promouvez toute mesure visant à optimiser et à améliorer les prestations offertes à la patientèle. Vous disposez d-indicateurs pour conduire l-amélioration continue de la qualité. Vous contribuez également au développement de nouvelles pratiques.
Votre esprit collaboratif vous permet de soutenir et développer l-interdisciplinarité entre tous les professionnelles et professionnels de la santé agissant sur la prise en charge des patientes et patients.
Vous gérez aisément la bonne allocation des ressources comme du matériel pour répondre aux besoins en soins des patients et patientes dans le cadre du budget alloué. Vous exercez également un rôle de référente ou référent pour les systèmes tarifaires en lien avec la profession
Selon les besoins, vous êtes amené ou amenée à recruter de nouvelles collaboratrices et collaborateurs et veillez au développement de leur expertise dans les champs de spécialité de chaque secteur tout en veillant à la polyvalence nécessaire des compétences

Vous êtes titulaire d'un Bachelor HES en nutrition et diététique ou d'un titre jugé équivalent, reconnu par la Croix-Rouge suisse.
Vous bénéficiez d'une expérience confirmée en management, acquise au travers d'au moins cinq années de pratique dans le domaine hospitalier. Une formation en management, telle qu'un CAS en management des institutions de santé, constitue un atout.
Dotée ou doté d'excellentes qualités relationnelles, vous faites preuve d'entregent et d'une communication positive. Vous savez fédérer les équipes autour d'objectifs communs et instaurer un climat de collaboration propice au bon fonctionnement du service.
Ouvert ou ouverte au changement, vous êtes capable d'accompagner les évolutions de votre environnement professionnel avec pragmatisme. Vous savez également prendre du recul sur vos pratiques managériales afin de les faire évoluer de manière continue.
Vous êtes une personne reconnue pour votre sens de l'organisation, votre flexibilité et votre capacité à gérer les priorités, vous êtes à l'aise dans un environnement où les activités sont variées et transversales.
Vous maîtrisez les outils informatiques courants et possédez une excellente maîtrise de la langue française.

* **Infopoint\-Betreuung:** Du betreust die eigene Tourist Information in Beckenried sowie die Partner\-Infopoints und entwickelst die physischen Auskunftsstellen der Region strategisch weiter.
· Vernetzer/in: Du pflegst den regelmässigen Austausch mit den Gemeinden, LTOs und Leistungsträgernund übernimmst die Leitung von Kommissionen und Projektgruppen.

* Kommunikative Persönlichkeit mit überzeugendem und argumentationsstarkem Auftreten
* Kenntnisse der Region oder die Begeisterung, dich darin zu verwurzeln
* Eine sehr hohe Eigenverantwortung, ausgeprägte Kreativität, lösungsorientiertes Denken und die Fähigkeit,dich in einem selbstorganisierten Umfeld sicher zu bewegen, bilden die Grundlage.

* Eine abwechslungsreiche und verantwortungsvolle Tätigkeit
* Ein zukunftsorientiertes und agiles Organisationsmodell mit flachen Hierarchien
* Enge Zusammenarbeit mit engagierten Tourismusakteuren in der Region
* Einen zentral gelegenen Arbeitsort in Stans im Herzen von Nidwalden

Vorweg, damit wir uns die Zeit sparen: Wir suchen keine Person, die Tickets von links nach rechts schiebt. Wir suchen jemanden, der einem Kunden auch mal widerspricht – mit guten Argumenten und Zahlen im Rücken.
Wenn du beim Wort „Freigabeprozess" innerlich aufatmest, wird das hier nichts. Wenn du beim Wort „Business Value" schon eine Rückfrage im Kopf hast: lies weiter.
Wer wir sind
creativestyle ist eine E-Commerce-Agentur mit deutsch-polnischem Setup: Projektmanagement in München, Entwicklung in Krakau und Rybnik. Über 120 umgesetzte Shops, rund 110 Leute, Kunden wie benuta, NKD, BRAX, CEWE Fotobuch, Einhell, Rieker und Bergzeit.
Dieses Jahr haben wir richtig abgeräumt: Agentur des Jahres, dazu zwei Auszeichnungen gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden – Best Customer Experience mit benuta, Best Mobile Experience mit Bergzeit.

Jede und jeder bei uns hat einen technischen Background. Die Geschäftsführung eingeschlossen.
50% Freiheit, 50% Verantwortung. Beides gilt gleichzeitig.
Fehler sind bei uns Lektionen, keine Schuldfrage. Wir steigen nur ungern zweimal in denselben Fluss.
Corporate sind wir nicht. Unzuverlässig allerdings auch nicht – und falls du glaubst, dass sich das ausschließt, beweisen wir dir gern das Gegenteil.
Wir nehmen keine Projekte an, auf die wir keine Lust haben. Aufgeräumt wird hier nur, was wir selbst angefangen haben.
Warum wir diese Stelle gerade jetzt besetzen

1. Wir bauen unser PIM- und ERP-Geschäft aus. Ab nächstem Jahr bieten wir Pimcore und Odoo an. Wir suchen jemanden, der diese Projekte nicht nur steuert, sondern Kunden im Workshop schon den Unterschied zwischen sauberem Datenmodell und teurer Migration zeigt.
2. Wir erfinden die PM-Rolle neu: In Zeiten von KI reicht bloßes Tickets-Schreiben nicht mehr – wir sind Innovationstreiber, keine Werkbank! Bei uns geht es um messbaren Impact, echtes Produktdenken und KI-Innovationen. Du steigst also in eine Rolle ein, die du aktiv mitgestalten kannst.
Aufgaben
Deine Mission
Projekte führen – von Anfang bis Betrieb. Du verantwortest Planung, Steuerung und Umsetzung großer E-Commerce-Projekte: Discovery, Konzept, Kickoff, Go-live und die Zeit danach. Technisch bewegen wir uns in Shopware, Adobe Commerce / Magento, commercetools, Pimcore und Storyblok.
Der Mensch sein, bei dem alles zusammenläuft. Du bist Hauptansprechpartner*in für unsere deutschsprachigen Kunden und die Brücke zu den Entwicklungsteams in Polen. Kundenbedürfnisse übersetzt du in saubere Lösungen, die Ideen des Teams bringst du zurück zum Kunden.
Impact – und zwar messbar. Messbar meinen wir wörtlich: Zu jeder Initiative gehören ein KPI und ein Tracking-Konzept, mit dem sich Vorher und Nachher belegen lassen.
Denken wie ein Product Owner. Behandle das Produkt wie dein eigenes! Wenn dich eine Funktion, ein Design oder eine Priorisierung nicht überzeugt, sprichst du es offen an. Bei unklarem Business Value stoppst du die Umsetzung, bis Klarheit herrscht. Die finale Entscheidung trifft der Kunde, klar – aber blind umgesetzt wird bei uns nichts.
Und der ganz normale Rest. Projektpläne, Timings, Budgets und Status-Reports hältst du zuverlässig auf Kurs. Meetings, Workshops, Sprint-Plannings und Retros moderierst du so, dass hinterher alle wissen, was Sache ist. Risiken erkennst du, bevor sie eins werden.
Deine Spezialisierung: PIM oder ERP
Hier liegt der Unterschied zu einer klassischen PM-Stelle. Eins von beidem bringst du mit:
PIM (Pimcore) – Du weißt, wie Produktdaten wirklich aussehen, bevor sie schön sind: Datenmodelle, Attribute, Varianten, Kanäle, Übersetzungen. Du hast schon mal eine Migration aus einer gewachsenen Excel-Landschaft begleitet und danach trotzdem noch an das Projekt geglaubt.
ERP (Odoo) – Bestände, Preise, Aufträge, Rechnungen, Schnittstellen. Du kannst einschätzen, was ins ERP gehört, was in den Shop und was besser in keins von beidem.
Beides mitzubringen wäre Angeberei – wir hätten aber nichts dagegen.
Du kommst aus einer vergleichbaren Welt, nur mit anderen Systemen (Akeneo, Contentserv, SAP, Business Central)? Dann sprich uns trotzdem an. Uns interessiert, ob du die Zusammenhänge verstehst, nicht welches Logo auf dem Login-Screen war.
Qualifikation
Du bist unser Mensch, wenn
Du mindestens 3 Jahre Projekte im digitalen Umfeld oder im E-Commerce geführt hast – von der ersten Idee bis in den Betrieb.
Du technisch mitreden kannst: APIs, PIM, ERP, Schnittstellen. Selbst programmieren musst du nicht. Verstehen, worüber die Devs gerade streiten, schon.
Scrum und Kanban dein Handwerkszeug sind und du Jira, Confluence und Miro im Schlaf bedienst.
Du fließend Deutsch (C2) und sehr gut Englisch sprichst – unsere Kunden sitzen im DACH-Raum, unsere Teams in Polen.
Du zwischen den Zeilen liest und Bedürfnisse erkennst, bevor sie im Briefing stehen.
Du aus einem leeren Blatt eine Roadmap machst: Backlog, Milestones, Budget, Timing.
Du KI-Tools schon im Alltag nutzt – oder große Lust hast, das in den nächsten Monaten zu ändern.
Du auch dann noch weißt, was zu tun ist, wenn der Deadline morgen und das Problem heute ist.
Pluspunkte sammelst du mit Erfahrung auf Händlerseite und mit Shopware und/oder Magento.
Wir bauen ein offenes Team. Bewirb dich unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, Herkunft, Orientierung, Religion oder Behinderung – uns interessiert, was du kannst und wie du denkst.

Was du bei uns bekommst
70.000 – 85.000 € , abhängig von Erfahrung und Spezialisierung. Konkrete Zahlen gibt es beim ersten Gespräch, nicht erst nach der dritten Runde.
Innovationsbudget für PoCs und eigene Ideen – bewusst als Investment gedacht, nicht als Restposten.
Weiterbildungsbudget inklusive Zertifizierungen (z. B. Shopware, Pimcore, …).
Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Home Office. Die Arbeit passt sich deinem Leben an, nicht umgekehrt.
Büro mit Dachterrasse im TRI München – plus MVV-Ticket, damit du auch hinkommst.
MacBook Pro und iPhone, ordentliche Peripherie inklusive.
Teamevents in Deutschland und Polen. Epische Trips nach Polen und die legendäre Revanche der polnischen Crew auf der Wiesn – eine Tradition mit Erfolgsgarantie!
Kaffee, Getränke und Obst. Muss man ja heute dazuschreiben.
Klingt nach dir?
Dann freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung!

Ashley Digital is the e-commerce engine behind Ashley Furniture Industries — one of the most recognized home brands in the world. As the world's largest manufacturer of home furnishings and the largest furniture store brand in North America, Ashley is in a category unto itself.

Our team sits at the intersection of world-class retail and digital innovation, driving the e-commerce experience for millions of customers across every platform and touchpoint. If you’ve shopped online for a mattress in the last decade, there’s a good chance you’ve already experienced our award-winning Nectar Sleep and DreamCloud.

We're a fast-moving, highly collaborative team operating at a transformational moment, and we're charged with shaping how people discover, explore, and buy home furnishings. Our expertise spans data science, performance marketing, product, and creative, and our work reaches millions of customers every day.

It's a rare combination: the energy of a tech company, the stability of an industry leader, and the opportunity to build something truly significant. If you're energized by transformation, collaboration, and meaningful impact at scale, Ashley Digital is where ambition meets opportunity.
To be considered for this remote opportunity, you must reside and be authorized to work within the United States.

The Strategic Program Manager is a high-impact, execution-focused role at the center of Ashley Digital's operating and reporting rhythm.

This individual will partner closely with senior leadership to own the structure and quality of the company's financial and operational reporting cadence — including MBRs, QBRs, and business infrastructure read-outs — ensuring information is accurate, well-organized, and decision-ready. At its core, this role is about synthesis and precision.

You will take financial, operational, and cross-functional inputs and translate them into sharp, structured outputs that reflect what matters most. This is a hands-on role for someone who is equally comfortable operating in ambiguity and executing at a high level of detail.

Success requires strong judgment, exceptional work ethic, and the ability to consistently produce high-quality work under tight timelines.

Own the MBR/QBR process and related business infrastructure read-outs — gathering inputs, synthesizing findings, and presenting clear, decision-ready updates to the Executive team
Build concise, high-quality presentations that communicate key insights, trends, and updates with precision and clarity
Partner closely with senior leaders to shape messaging, structure communication, and maintain a consistent operating cadence
Prepare materials for executive forums, ensuring content is tightly constructed, well-supported, and aligned to key priorities
Identify key themes, risks, and opportunities across the business by connecting signals across multiple inputs, and educating cross functional teams as needed
Drive follow-through on key actions and decisions, ensuring alignment and accountability across stakeholders
Continuously improve how information is gathered, structured, and communicated across the organization
Operate as a trusted, detail-oriented partner who can independently manage critical workstreams from start to finish
The responsibilities described above are not exhaustive. You may be asked, from time to time and as reasonably required by business needs, to perform other duties consistent with your skills and role, including work for or on behalf of our related entities. This job description does not constitute a contract of employment and may be modified at any time, subject to applicable law

3-5 years of experience in high-growth technology companies, business operations, banking, consulting, or roles requiring strong written communication and cross-functional coordination with executive leadership
Bachelor's degree required; MBA, a plus.
Comfort working with financial and operational data to support executive reporting cycles.
Experience in investment banking, private equity, or management consulting (special projects/chief of staff functions) strongly preferred.
Exceptional ability to structure ambiguous problems and synthesize large amounts of information into clear, concise outputs
Strong presentation skills, with a demonstrated ability to create polished, executive-level materials
High attention to detail and consistently strong judgment on what matters and how to communicate it
Ability to operate with speed and precision in a fast-paced, high-expectation environment
Comfortable working with senior leaders and navigating cross-functional stakeholders
Strong ownership mindset and willingness to take on highly iterative, detail-oriented work
Experience in high-growth, e-commerce, or direct-to-consumer businesses is a plus

We are looking for a **Senior QA Compliance and Auditing Manager** to join our Compliance & Auditing Team !

As a Senior QA Compliance and Auditing Manager, you will play a key role in ensuring GMP/GDP compliance across our operations. Main tasks will include:
* Lead and manage the supplier qualification and lifecycle management program, including qualification, periodic evaluation, requalification, and performance monitoring of GMP/GDP service providers and suppliers.
* Support the design, negotiation, implementation, and maintenance of Technical Quality Agreements (TQAs) and other quality-related contracts with external partners.
* Establish, maintain, and continuously improve supplier oversight processes using a risk-based approach.
* Lead the planning, execution, reporting, and follow-up of GMP/GDP audits of suppliers, contractors, distributors, and service providers.
* Participate in the establishment and oversight of the annual external audit program and internal self-inspection schedule based on risk assessment.
* Promptly escalate critical compliance risks and audit findings to management and ensure effective CAPA implementation.
* Manage, review, and approve change controls, deviations, CAPAs and investigations.
* Lead the development, review, and maintenance of quality procedures and compliance-related documentation.
* Manage and maintain quality documentation systems and ensure inspection readiness.
* Coordinate and support Health Authority inspections and customer audits.
* Monitor evolving GMP/GDP regulations and industry expectations and proactively implement necessary compliance improvements.
* Support the optimization of the Quality System through KPI monitoring, quality metrics, management reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Support cross-functional compliance activities and quality initiatives as needed, including Computerized Systems Validation (CSV), Data Integrity, Pharmacovigilance (GVP), Clinical Quality (GCP), and other GxP-related compliance tasks.
* Promote a strong quality culture and GxP mindset across the organization.
* Travel domestically and internationally as required to support supplier qualifications and audit activities.

* University degree in Pharmacy, Chemistry, Biotechnology, Life Sciences, or another relevant scientific discipline (Master's degree preferred).
* Minimum 7 years of experience in pharmaceutical Quality Assurance, Compliance, Supplier Quality, Manufacturing Quality, or related GxP functions.
* Demonstrated experience managing supplier qualification programs and conducting GMP/GDP audits as Lead Auditor.
* Strong knowledge of pharmaceutical development, manufacturing, packaging, testing, storage, and distribution activities.
* Excellent knowledge of relevant GMP/GDP regulations and international quality standards, including EU GMP, EU GDP, ICH, PIC/S, WHO, FDA, and ISO requirements.
* Proven ability to independently interpret regulations and implement pragmatic, risk-based compliance solutions.
* Experience in developing and managing Quality Agreements and external partner oversight programs.
* Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.
* Excellent analytical, organizational, and problem-solving capabilities.
* Confident, proactive, and capable of influencing stakeholders at all organizational levels.
* Strong interpersonal, communication, and leadership skills.
* Knowledge of other GxP areas such as Pharmacovigilance (GVP), Clinical Quality (GCP), Computerized Systems Validation (CSV), or Data Integrity requirements would be a strong advantage.
* Fluent in English; knowledge of another European language is considered an asset.

Senior CIAM Specialist \& Project Manager (a) (80\-100%)
========================================================
**Die Kantonalbank (ZKB) ist die grösste Kantonalbank und zweitgrösste Universalbank der Schweiz. im Wirtschaftsraum Zürich verankert, verbindet sie wirtschaftliche Stabilität und langfristige Orientierung mit der konsequenten Weiterentwicklung ihrer digitalen Angebote. Das Ziel: persönlich wie digital ein überzeugendes Kundenerlebnis zu bieten.
Genau hier setzt der Bereich Client Channels an. Im Fokus stehen zentrale digitale und physische Touchpoints zwischen der ZKB und ihren Kundinnen und Kunden, die Bedürfnisse mit Technologie, Prozessen, User Experience, Security und Betrieb verbinden. Dazu gehören unter anderem eBanking, Mobile Banking sowie digitale öffnungs\-, Onboarding\- und Lifecycle\-Prozesse.**
**Innerhalb von Client Channels bildet das Team Digitale Kundenschnittstelle das Bindeglied zwischen Strategie und Umsetzung. Strategische Themen werden konkretisiert, Konzepte entwickelt und für die Umsetzung vorbereitet. Im Bereich Customer Identity \& Access Management (CIAM) steht dabei eine zentrale Frage im Fokus: Wie lassen sich sichere Authentifizierungs\- und Autorisierungsprozesse mit einem überzeugenden digitalen Kundenerlebnis verbinden?**
**Für die Weiterentwicklung dieses strategisch wichtigen Themenfelds suchen wir dich als Senior CIAM Specialist \& Project Manager.**
**Deine Herausforderung**
* Du steuerst CIAM\-Projekte (Scope, Time \& Budget) und bringst gleichzeitig deine fachliche Expertise in die konzeptionelle Weiterentwicklung ein, mit einem Schwerpunkt von rund 60% Projektleitung und 40% CIAM\-Facharbeit
* Verantwortung und Begleitung mehrerer CIAM\-Projekte von der ersten Konkretisierung bis zur Übergabe in die Umsetzung– einschliesslich der Markteinführung mit einem Launch\-Konzept und passender Kommunikation
* Analyse fachlicher, technischer und regulatorischer Anforderungen und Überführung in konkrete Lösungsansätze
* Weiterentwicklung von Strategien und Konzepten rund um CIAM, Authentifizierung und Autorisierung
* Analyse und Optimierung bestehender Authentifizierungs\-, Sicherheits\- und Zugriffsprozesse
* Koordination interner und externer Fachpersonen sowie adressatengerechte Aufbereitung komplexer Themen für unterschiedliche Stakeholder
* Beobachtung technologischer, regulatorischer und marktseitiger Entwicklungen im CIAM\-Umfeld und Ableitung relevanter Handlungsfelder
**Deine Qualitäten und Begabungen**
* Ausbildung in (Wirtschafts\-)Informatik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung (HF/FH/Universität) oder mehrjährige relevante Berufserfahrung
* Mehrjährige, fundierte CIAM\-Erfahrung mit Fokus auf Konzeption und Umsetzung sowie gutes Verständnis von Authentifizierungs\- und Autorisierungsmethoden
* Technisches Verständnis von CIAM\-Frameworks, Sicherheitsarchitekturen und den zugrunde liegenden Abläufen
* Fundierte Erfahrung in der Leitung von Projekten und im Stakeholder\-Management
* Kenntnisse regulatorischer und datenschutzrechtlicher Anforderungen
* Strategische und analytische Denkweise sowie echtes Interesse daran, das Themenfeld CIAM langfristig weiterzuentwickeln
* Fliessende Deutschkenntnisse auf mindestens C1\-Niveau
**Als Senior CIAM Specialist \& Project Manager gestaltest du geschäftskritische digitale Kundenschnittstellen von der ersten Idee bis zur Umsetzung mit. Reizt dich die Möglichkeit, Sicherheit und Benutzerfreundlichkeit in einem strategisch wichtigen Themenfeld aktiv miteinander zu verbinden?**

Reiseleiter:innen bringen Gruppen durch fremdes Gelände. Sie kennen die Route, merken, wer nicht mehr mag und erklären zum fünften Mal geduldig dasselbe. Genau so jemanden suchen wir. Nur führt deine Route nicht durch Patagonien, sondern durch die HR\-Prozesse unserer Kund:innen.
Deine Reisegruppe.
KMU, Treuhandunternehmen und Kanzleien, die ihre HR\-Prozesse endlich in den Griff kriegen wollen. Die einen wissen genau, wohin sie möchten. Die anderen merken erst unterwegs, dass der bisherige Weg ein Umweg war. Beide brauchen jemanden, der vorangeht.
Deine Route.
* Du leitest Projekte zur Einführung und Optimierung von Abacus HR, von der Analyse bis zum Go\-live.
* Du schaust dir die HR\-Prozesse beim Kunden an und setzt sie in Abacus um: Personaladministration, Ein\- und Austritte, Mitarbeitergespräche, Absenzen, Mitarbeiterportal, HR\-Reporting, Recruiting und vieles mehr.
* Du schulst die Key\-User und begleitest sie, bis sie selber losgehen können.
* Du entwickelst bestehende Kundenlösungen weiter und bringst sie auf das nächste Level
* Du baust unser HR\-Angebot mit auf. Die Stelle ist neu, du prägst sie mit.
Dein Werdegang zur Reiseleitung: viele Wege führen zum Ziel.
**Du kennst das Gelände.** Du hast Erfahrung mit den Abacus HR\-Modulen und hast sie bei Kund:innen schon aufgesetzt. Das Terrain ist dir vertraut, jetzt willst du die Gruppe führen.
**Du kennst die Gruppe.** Du kommst aus dem HR, hast Prozesse gelebt und optimiert und willst die Seite wechseln, weil du weisst, wie es besser geht. Das Gelände zeigen wir dir, die Kosten für die Abacus\-Zertifizierungen übernehmen wir.
Beides führt zum selben Treffpunkt. Was zählt, ist, dass du Menschen sicher ans Ziel bringst.
Ehrlich gesagt
Diese Stelle gab es bei uns noch nie. Einiges ist im Aufbau, nicht jeder Prozess ist fertig und du wirst Fragen stellen, auf die wir noch keine Antwort haben. Dafür gestaltest du von Anfang an mit, statt in eine fertige Rolle zu rutschen. Wenn du lieber mitbaust, als fertige Wege abzulaufen, bist du bei uns richtig.
Dein Gepäck
* Mehrjährige Erfahrung auf Senior\-Level, aus der Abacus\-Welt oder aus dem HR
* Ausbildung im HR (z. B. HR\-Fachausweis, eidg. Diplom, CAS/MAS in HRM) oder im Bereich Wirtschaft/Wirtschaftsinformatik
* Projekterfahrung: Du hast Projekte geleitet oder massgeblich mitgetragen
* Klare Kommunikation: Du erklärst Komplexes einfach, der Geschäftsleitung genauso wie den Key\-Usern
* Startup\-Tempo: Wechselnde Prioritäten stören dich nicht, du findest pragmatische Lösungen
* Du bist gerne bei Kund:innen vor Ort und gibst gerne Schulungen

Responsable d’unité Études et Réalisations Multi\-fluides à 80\-100%
==========================================================================
Le Service des énergies garantit la distribution de l’électricité, du gaz et de l’eau potable à Yverdon\-les\-Bains, ainsi qu’à de nombreux villages voisins, tout en assurant la gestion du réseau d’éclairage public. Inspiré par le Plan climat 2023, il place le développement durable au centre de ses projets et s’engage à promouvoir l’efficience énergétique et les énergies renouvelables, contribuant activement à la transition énergétique de toute la région.
Afin de renforcer son département réseaux de distribution, le département Réseaux de distribution est à la recherche d’un·e :
Responsable d’unité Études et Réalisations Multi\-fluides à 80\-100%
==========================================================================
**Vos missions principales et responsabilités :**
* Assurer l’organisation et la gestion des activités de l’unité.
* Piloter, coordonner et garantir la bonne réalisation des études et des projets liés aux réseaux de distribution multi\-fluide : eau, gaz, électricité, éclairage public, fibre optique ainsi que des ouvrages relatifs.
* Assurer le suivi et le respect des préavis d'investissement, des budgets et des règles techniques, sécuritaires et normatives (SIA, VSS) liés à l'unité.
* Assurer la bonne exécution des projets de génie civil et infrastructures, la production des plans et schémas d'ouvrage ainsi que leur transmission à l'exploitation.
* Garantir le lien entre le processus d'asset management et les processus de réalisation.
* Participer à la réalisation des appels d'offres marchés publics (AOMP)et assurer le suivi de la sous\-traitance et des partenaires.
* Coordonner les activités de l'unité avec les autres unités du service, la Ville et les sociétés filles (YCAD, SAGENORD), ainsi qu'avec les partenaires externes (bureaux d'ingénieurs, entreprises, GRD, entreprise GC sous\-traitantes).
* Assurer la veille technique, réglementaire et normative, y compris sur les évolutions technologiques (BIM, etc.).
* Assurer une permanence de direction selon un tournus établi.
**Votre profil :**
* Vous êtes titulaire d'un diplôme d'ingénieur·e HES ou EPF en génie civil, ou titre équivalent.
* Vous justifiez d'une formation complémentaire en gestion de projet, une formation en gestion d’équipe est un atout.
* Expérience confirmée d'au moins 5 ans dans la conduite de personnel et la gestion de projets de construction multi\-fluide.
* Bonnes connaissances des réseaux de distribution (eau, gaz, électricité, chaleur) ainsi que des normes et règlementations en vigueur (SIA, VSS, SVGW, AEAI, ESTI).
* Maîtrise des outils bureautiques usuels (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) et des logiciels métier de type AutoCAD.
* Vous faites preuve d'autonomie, d'efficacité et d'esprit d'initiative, et savez atteindre les objectifs qui vous sont fixés.
* Curiosité intellectuelle et intérêt marqué pour les systèmes techniques et énergétiques, notamment les réseaux de distribution.
* Vous êtes sensibles aux enjeux du service public et adhérez à ses missions et à ses valeurs.
* De bonnes connaissances de l'anglais sont demandées ; des notions d'allemand constituent un atout.
* Vous êtes titulaire du permis de conduire catégorie B et faites preuve de disponibilité et de flexibilité dans vos horaires.
**Ce que nous vous offrons :**
* La possibilité de piloter un portefeuille de projets variés et stratégiques pour la transition énergétique du territoire, avec un niveau élevé d'autonomie.
* Un poste à responsabilités vous permettant de marquer de votre empreinte le développement multi\-fluide des réseaux de distribution et ses infrastructures.
* Un travail au sein d'une équipe de spécialistes motivé·es, dans un domaine en pleine mutation, au sein d'une ville engagée activement dans la transition énergétique et numérique.
* Une collaboration étroite avec les équipes opérationnelles, les bureaux d'ingénieurs, les entreprises partenaires et les organismes réglementaires pour garantir la conformité aux normes de sécurité et de qualité.
